name: Marvel's Jessica Jones
description: After a tragic ending to her short-lived super hero stint, Jessica Jones is rebuilding her personal life and career as a detective who gets pulled into cases involving people with extraordinary abilities in New York City.

videos.title: AKA Ladies Night
videos.overview: Jessica Jones is hired to find a pretty NYU student who's vanished, but it turns out to be more than a simple missing persons case.

videos.title: AKA Crush Syndrome
videos.overview: Jessica vows to prove Hope's innocence, even though it means tracking down a terrifying figure from her own past.

videos.title: AKA It's Called Whiskey
videos.overview: It won't be easy to acquire or deploy, but Jessica thinks she's found a weapon to use against Kilgrave. Luke and Jessica bond over their similarities.

videos.title: AKA 99 Friends
videos.overview: A new case demands attention as Jessica tries to find out who's spying on her for Kilgrave. Trish's radio show yields unexpected consequences.

videos.title: AKA The Sandwich Saved Me
videos.overview: Despite Jessica's objections, Trish's new friend Simpson gets involved in the hunt for Kilgrave. Jessica recalls a pivotal moment in her life.

videos.title: AKA You're a Winner!
videos.overview: Luke hires Jessica to help him find someone who may have skipped town, but she fears he'll learn too much about her history in the process.

videos.title: AKA Top Shelf Perverts
videos.overview: Malcolm, Simpson and Trish go rogue to prevent Jessica from carrying out an extreme plan to outwit Kilgrave.

videos.title: AKA WWJD?
videos.overview: Jessica experiences a strange homecoming courtesy of Kilgrave. Hograth's conflict with her estranged wife reaches a tipping point.

videos.title: AKA Sin Bin
videos.overview: Just when Jessica has Kilgrave right where she want's him, Hogarth's involvement complicates the situation. Details of Kilgrave's past emerge.

videos.title: AKA 1,000 Cuts
videos.overview: A discovery has the potential to change the entire game - if Jessica can refuse Kilgrave's offer.

videos.title: AKA I've Got the Blues
videos.overview: Jessica searches morgues for clues. Trish goes all out to keep Simpson from getting in Jessica's way. Malcolm has an epiphany.

videos.title: AKA Take a Bloody Number
videos.overview: The hunt for Kilgrave reunites Jessica with Luke. Trish receives some unexpected information about Simpson and Jessica.

videos.title: AKA Smile
videos.overview: Jessica and Luke get help from someone else in the neighborhood. Kilgrave gears up for a major test of powers against Jessica.

videos.title: AKA Start at the Beginning
videos.overview: While Jessica deals with a rival PI and a paranoid would-be client, Trish digs up a medical file that could unlock the mystery of Jessica's powers.

videos.title: AKA Freak Accident
videos.overview: Jessica sets out to find Dr. Kozlov and makes a startling discovery. Trish recruits Malcolm for backup as she visits a figure from her past.

videos.title: AKA Sole Survivor
videos.overview: As her visions intensify, Jessica visits an abandoned clinic, where she stumbles on a new lead. Jeri faces an ultimatum after her secret gets out.

videos.title: AKA God Help the Hobo
videos.overview: Between anger management classes and tabloid scandals, Jessica and Trish track down a third patient linked to IGH. Oscar extends an olive branch.

videos.title: AKA The Octopus
videos.overview: Backed into a corner, Jessica's forced to share her intel on the killer. A groggy Trish tries to pull herself together before an important meeting.

videos.title: AKA Facetime
videos.overview: Jessica gate-crashes an exclusive country club on the hunt for the killer, and Trish's new addiction begins to spiral out of control.

videos.title: AKA I Want Your Cray Cray
videos.overview: Flashbacks shed new light on the aftermath of the family's car accident and reveal a painful turning point in Jessica's adult life.

videos.title: AKA Ain't We Got Fun
videos.overview: While Jessica debates her next move, Malcolm confronts Trish about her erratic behavior, and Jeri makes contact with a healer.

videos.title: AKA Shark in the Bathtub, Monster in the Bed
videos.overview: The shooting forces Jessica to rethink her plans. Meanwhile, Oscar asks for help with a family crisis, and Trish's frustrations finally boil over.

videos.title: AKA Pork Chop
videos.overview: Jeri finagles a deal for her new client in exchange for Karl's location. Trish forges ahead with her own investigation. A prison guard crosses a line.

videos.title: AKA Three Lives and Counting
videos.overview: Shocked by her own actions and haunted by visions of Kilgrave, Jessica worries she's turning into a monster. Trish's plans for Karl become clear.

videos.title: AKA Pray for My Patsy
videos.overview: As Jessica and Dorothy wait anxiously for updates on Trish, a call from Costa brings alarming news. Jeri hatches a plan to get her revenge.

videos.title: AKA Playland
videos.overview: Waking up in unfamiliar surroundings, Jessica once again finds herself torn between two worlds and facing an impossible choice.

videos.title: AKA The Perfect Burger
videos.overview: As Jessica focuses on helping the helpless, Dorothy Walker shows up at Alias to beg for help finding a missing Trish.

videos.title: AKA You're Welcome
videos.overview: Tensions run high between Jessica and Trish as Trish hones her new catlike skills and scours the city for a chance to be a hero.

videos.title: AKA I Have No Spleen
videos.overview: Itching to get back out on the streets and find her attacker, Jessica defies her doctor's advice. Jeri reconnects with her college flame Kith.

videos.title: AKA Customer Service is Standing By
videos.overview: Jessica learns there's more to Erik than meets the eye as they track down three potential attackers. Malcolm digs up dirt on Kith's husband.

videos.title: AKA I Wish
videos.overview: Teaming up with Trish to stake out Sallinger, Jessica makes a startling discovery. Jeri's plot to expose Peter yields unexpected consequences.

videos.title: AKA Sorry Face
videos.overview: As the police sift through the gruesome crime scene, Jessica and Trish race to find Sallinger's latest captive.

videos.title: AKA The Double Half-Wappinger
videos.overview: Jessica and Trish go on a road trip to dig into Sallinger's past and unearth a horrifying discovery.

videos.title: AKA Camera Friendly
videos.overview: When Sallinger posts a video teasing his next crime, Jessica responds with her own media play. Jeri demands that Malcolm identify the masked woman.

videos.title: AKA I Did Something Today
videos.overview: After a shocking blow, Jessica's forced to choose between protecting Trish and destroying Sallinger. Jeri seizes a chance to get back in Kith's life.

videos.title: AKA Hero Pants
videos.overview: Jessica wrestles with her emotions as she tries to untangle herself from a murder investigation.

videos.title: AKA Hellcat
videos.overview: Trish revisits her troubled childhood with Dorothy while plotting to stop Sallinger and stamp out evil across the city.

videos.title: AKA A Lotta Worms
videos.overview: As Trish makes a move on Sallinger, Jessica intervenes -- and ends up caught in a harrowing dance with the killer.

videos.title: AKA Everything
videos.overview: An old friend visits Jessica as she sets out on an agonizing mission and learns the true cost of being a hero.

awards: Won 1 Primetime Emmy. 12 wins & 27 nominations total
